messages:
eve: heads-up — ran into inconsistencies between SDKs when handling HTTP errors. python exceptions only carry a message string; TS SDK returns an object. breaks our onboarding samples that inspect status/retry info.

sam: oh no. can you paste a minimal repro?

eve: sure. current behavior: in JS fetch we get body: { \"error\": \"Unauthorized\", \"message\": \"Invalid api key\" } and we throw an SDKError with .status = 401. Python just raises requests.HTTPError('401 Client Error') with no attributes.

maria: this explains the flaky sample where we do `if err.status == 429: backoff()` in the python quickstart. :grimacing:

jun: proposal: agree on a stable HTTP error JSON and map it to typed exceptions in each SDK. canonical fields: error_type, status, message, retry_after, error_schema_version. Example:
```json
{\n  \"error_type\": \"rate_limit\",\n  \"status\": 429,\n  \"message\": \"Rate limit exceeded\",\n  \"retry_after\": 10,\n  \"error_schema_version\": \"1.0\"\n}
```

sam: SDK surface: add ErrorBase with properties .status, .type, .retry_after, .retryable, and .raw_body. Then concrete classes: RateLimitError, AuthError, ServiceUnavailableError, BadRequestError.

maria: please ensure .raw_body exists but is documented as optional; mobile SDKs may not include it.

eve: also add helper `sdk.is_retryable(err)` to prevent each codebase reimplementing mapping rules.

jun: for TS I'll use a discriminated union: type SDKError = RateLimitError | AuthError | ... with `error_type` as discriminator. For python I'll add subclasses and keep a compat alias HTTPError -> new base that wraps old exceptions but emits a DeprecationWarning.

sam: mapping table suggestion (short): 400 -> BadRequestError (retryable=false), 401/403 -> AuthError (retryable=false), 429 -> RateLimitError (retryable=true, check retry_after), 503 -> ServiceUnavailableError (retryable=true), 5xx other -> ServerError (retryable=true). Add nuance for streaming endpoints: ensure we surface canonical JSON before sending chunked body.

eve: important: version the schema with error_schema_version. if we need to add fields later we bump the version and document migration.

maria: tests and samples: add a tiny sample app that shows exponential backoff using retry_after when present, and fallback to jittered backoff if absent. include both JS and python examples.

sam: ops-bot: can you link the draft PRs?

ops-bot: Draft PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/88, https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/412 — both add ErrorBase and RateLimitError, plus unit tests.

jun: note on implementation: runtime should emit the canonical JSON for non-2xx responses. For streaming, if an error occurs before the first data chunk, return the JSON with appropriate headers; if mid-stream, send a final error chunk with an agreed marker. Need to sync with eng-runtime.

eve: can eng-runtime add a switch to force error wrapper on streaming endpoints? we need a dev-friendly opt-in so we don't break existing streaming consumers.

sam: i'll coordinate with runtime owners. plan: add the mapping table to docs, land SDK changes in sprint, add samples/tests, and ship a small runtime compatibility flag.

maria: +1. add a note in onboarding docs about using sdk.is_retryable() rather than inspecting status directly.

jun: i'll open follow-up issues to add discriminated unions in TS and subclasses in py, plus deprecation plan for raw HTTPError usage.

eve: priority: high for DX; small code changes but big win for sample reliability. tagging owners: @jun (sdk impls), @sam (docs + mapping), @maria (samples/tests), @eng-runtime (streaming behavior).

sam: thanks all. i'll create the short mapping table and a snippet for the quickstart today.
